data.name: AimArena
data.detailed_description:
Aim was everything — a lightning-fast 1v1 FPS aim duel. Win by depleting your opponent’s HP.

AAAim54 is a 1v1-focused competitive FPS built primarily for aim training—precision, reaction speed, and consistency.
Matches are short and repeatable, so you can run rapid rounds, improve through pure gunplay, and move straight into the next match.

Goal / Win Condition

  • Fight in 1v1 and reduce your opponent’s HP to zero to win

  • Matches end quickly, letting you rematch and keep practicing

Match Flow

  • Match start → weapon selection → 1v1 fight → winner decided → rematch / next match

Aim-Training Focus

  • Short rounds + instant rematches to maximize repetition

  • Clear outcomes make it easy to spot what to improve (accuracy, timing, consistency)

  • Improve flicks, tracking, and shot timing through repeated duels

Content

  • Shooting customization: configure settings for the type of aim training you need

  • Character customization: practice with a play feel inspired by other FPS titles

  • Offline practice: warm up and fine-tune your aim between online matches

Online Features

  • Ranked Match (matchmaking): jump into 1v1 instantly

  • Custom Room (Spectate + Entry Queue Rotation):
    Friends can join as spectators while two players fight. Spectators can enter the challenger queue, and after each match the next player in the queue rotates in to duel—perfect for king-of-the-hill / rotation-style sessions.

  • Global leaderboards to compete with players worldwide

Server / Connectivity

  • Built specifically for 1v1, the game automatically selects a server to keep both players’ experience as balanced as possible

  • Custom netcode is designed to minimize gameplay impact even as spectator count increases

Single-player Content

  • AAAim54 is primarily an online competitive aim-training experience (no story campaign)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Online multiplayer requires an internet connection.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Target: 1080p / 60 FPS (may vary by settings).
